limits: Autonomous, standing schedules, notification/call escalation, broaderM7 and all twelve Options acceptance groups remain incomplete.
Unknown steering remains sticky per task/base revision; inspection and Stop/confirmed retirement permit a new task. This increment does not implement same-task native intent consumption/retirement.
Protected unforked, non-rolled-back SQLite is assumed; no defense against a malicious or cloned database is claimed. Older binaries must be quiesced before enabling this authority.

A trusted original creating Store may initialize on-demand only before its own first registration attempt. If it races an independent initializing controller, first native commit wins; an uncommitted Off intent is not persisted authority.
Record caps refuse new records without pruning. Generation exhaustion prevents new controller startup; already registered mode/intent retained lookup remains available.

A direct internal runtime call can await an uncooperative source adapter; the production HTTP route supplies the outerdeadline. No separate Session ingress deadline or distributed execution lease is asserted.

Actual task/file/API/client checks use synthetic inputs and ScriptedProvider, not paid inference or human voice. No model quality, latency distribution, device calling or whole-roadmap qualification follows.
No user model, credentials, live preview/deployment or configuration changed; no dependency installation; zero paid calls in this increment.
